```{r stage7-prep}
# ---- Single-family switch (protocol addendum 2.3 and 3.1) ---------------------------------
# Tables: both versions are built in R and the page shows one at a time.
sw_n <- 0
sf_switch <- function(all_html, sf_html) {
  sw_n <<- sw_n + 1; id <- paste0("sfsw", sw_n)
  js <- function(show, hide) sprintf("document.getElementById('%s_%s').style.display='';document.getElementById('%s_%s').style.display='none';", id, show, id, hide)
  HTML(paste0('<div style="margin: 8px 0 2px 0; font-size: 13px;"><b>Show:</b> ',
              '<label style="font-weight: normal; margin: 0 12px 0 6px;"><input type="radio" name="', id, '" checked onchange="', js("all", "sf"), '"> All properties</label>',
              '<label style="font-weight: normal; margin: 0;"><input type="radio" name="', id, '" onchange="', js("sf", "all"), '"> Single-family properties only</label></div>',
              '<div id="', id, '_all">', paste(as.character(all_html), collapse = "\n"), '</div>',
              '<div id="', id, '_sf" style="display: none;">', paste(as.character(sf_html), collapse = "\n"), '</div>'))
}
# Charts: one of two widgets is shown; the one revealed is resized to its container.
chart_switch <- function(w_sf, w_mf) {
  sw_n <<- sw_n + 1; id <- paste0("chsw", sw_n)
  js <- function(show, hide) sprintf("var s=document.getElementById('%s_%s'),h=document.getElementById('%s_%s');h.style.display='none';s.style.display='';var p=s.querySelector('.plotly');if(p&&window.Plotly){Plotly.Plots.resize(p);}", id, show, id, hide)
  tagList(HTML(paste0('<div style="margin: 8px 0 2px 0; font-size: 13px;"><b>Show:</b> ',
                      '<label style="font-weight: normal; margin: 0 12px 0 6px;"><input type="radio" name="', id, '" checked onchange="', js("sf", "mf"), '"> Single-family properties</label>',
                      '<label style="font-weight: normal; margin: 0;"><input type="radio" name="', id, '" onchange="', js("mf", "sf"), '"> Multi-family properties</label></div>')),
          tags$div(id = paste0(id, "_sf"), w_sf), tags$div(id = paste0(id, "_mf"), style = "display: none;", w_mf))
}
# Maps: a tick box hides projects on other property types. Each listed layer group keeps
# its layers in the order they were drawn; data.groups[g] gives, per layer, whether it shows
# with the box off (all) and on (sf). data.labels recounts a group of printed tract labels.
sf_toggle_js <- "
  function(el, x, data) {
    var map = this, stash = {}, labs = null;
    function arr(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]; }
    Object.keys(data.groups).forEach(function(g) {
      var lg = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup(g, false); if (!lg) return;
      var a = []; lg.eachLayer(function(l) { a.push(l); }); stash[g] = {lg: lg, a: a};
    });
    if (data.labels) {
      var lgl = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup(data.labels.group, false);
      if (lgl) { labs = []; lgl.eachLayer(function(l) { labs.push(l); }); }
    }
    var ctrl = L.control({position: data.position || 'topright'});
    ctrl.onAdd = function() {
      var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
      div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px';
      div.innerHTML = '<label style=\"font-weight: normal; margin: 0;\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"sf-only\"> Single-family properties only</label>';
      L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
      return div;
    };
    ctrl.addTo(map);
    function update() {
      var sf = el.querySelector('.sf-only').checked;
      Object.keys(stash).forEach(function(g) {
        var s = stash[g], keep = arr(data.groups[g][sf ? 'sf' : 'all']);
        s.a.forEach(function(l, i) {
          if (+keep[i] === 1) { if (!s.lg.hasLayer(l)) s.lg.addLayer(l); } else if (s.lg.hasLayer(l)) s.lg.removeLayer(l);
        });
      });
      if (labs) { var v = arr(data.labels[sf ? 'sf' : 'all']); labs.forEach(function(l, i) { l.setTooltipContent(String(v[i])); }); }
    }
    el.querySelector('.sf-only').addEventListener('change', update);
  }"

```

# Citywide

The citywide section covers every Community Plan Area. Each project is assigned to the CPA of its parcel (APN, then City PIN, then coordinates), and to the permit's CPA text only when no parcel is found. The report counts `r fmt(nrow(adu))` ADUs with `r fmt(sum(adu$units))` units: `r fmt(sum(adu$units[adu$source_tag == tag_levels[1]]))` units on LADBS permitted ADUs (`r ladbs_window`), `r fmt(sum(adu$units[adu$source_tag == tag_levels[2]]))` on older permitted ADUs (2010 to 2016) and `r fmt(sum(adu$units[adu$source_tag == tag_levels[3]]))` grandfathered ADUs from the 2026 Assessor roll. Every table, chart and map below counts the three groups together.

## ADU units by year and status

```{r c1-yearly}
c1_build <- function(a) {
  yrs <- a %>% group_by(issue_year) %>%
    summarise(projects = n(),
              completed = sum(units[status == "Completed"]),
              in_progress = sum(units[status == "In progress"]),
              stalled = sum(units[status == "Stalled"]),
              units = sum(units), .groups = "drop") %>%   # total last: it would mask the column above
    mutate(share = completed / units)
  tot <- yrs %>% summarise(across(c(projects, units, completed, in_progress, stalled), sum)) %>%
    mutate(issue_year = 9999, share = completed / units)
  list(yrs = yrs, tot = tot)
}
c1_table <- function(b, what) bind_rows(b$yrs, b$tot) %>%
  transmute(`Issue year` = case_when(issue_year == 9999 ~ "Total", is.na(issue_year) ~ "No permit year (grandfathered)",
                                     issue_year == year(data_asof) ~ paste0(issue_year, " (to ", format(data_asof, "%b %e") %>% str_squish(), ")"),
                                     TRUE ~ as.character(issue_year)),
            `ADUs (projects)` = fmt(projects), `ADU units` = fmt(units), Completed = fmt(completed),
            `In progress` = fmt(in_progress), Stalled = fmt(stalled), `Share completed` = pct(share)) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("ADUs and ADU units by issue year, with units by status, citywide, ", what, " (ADUs; ADU units)"),
      note = paste0("Year of the project's first ADU permit: 2010 to 2016 are older permitted ADUs, 2017 on are LADBS permitted ADUs. Grandfathered ADUs come from the Assessor roll, have no permit year and count as completed. Status: completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC anywhere in the permit chain; stalled = no permit status change since ",
                    format(stall_cutoff, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish(), ". Covers ", window_label, "; ", year(data_asof), " is a partial year."))
c1_all <- c1_build(adu); c1_sf <- c1_build(filter(adu, is_sfp)); c1 <- c1_all$yrs
qa_add(7, "Units by year and status: completed + in progress + stalled = units, every year, all properties and single-family only", "all years", "checked",
       all(c1$completed + c1$in_progress + c1$stalled == c1$units) &&
         all(with(c1_sf$yrs, completed + in_progress + stalled == units)) && sum(c1_sf$yrs$units) <= sum(c1$units) && sum(c1$units) == sum(adu$units), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
sf_switch(c1_table(c1_all, "all properties"), c1_table(c1_sf, "single-family properties only"))
```

## ADU units by property type

```{r c1b-property-type}
# Shares are shares of ADU units (decision recorded in the protocol addendum, section 2.2).
pt_levels <- c("Single-family", "Multi-family", "Other or unknown")
c1b <- adu %>% mutate(pt = factor(if_else(property_type %in% pt_levels[1:2], property_type, pt_levels[3]), levels = pt_levels)) %>%
  group_by(pt) %>%
  summarise(properties = n_distinct(prop_id[!is.na(prop_id)]) + sum(is.na(prop_id)), projects = n(),
            completed = sum(units[status == "Completed"]), units = sum(units), .groups = "drop")
c1b_tot <- c1b %>% summarise(across(c(properties, projects, completed, units), sum)) %>% mutate(pt = "All properties")
qa_add(7, "Units by property type: rows sum to the citywide total", fmt(sum(adu$units)), fmt(sum(c1b$units)), sum(c1b$units) == sum(adu$units), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
bind_rows(c1b %>% mutate(pt = as.character(pt)), c1b_tot) %>%
  transmute(`Property type` = pt, `ADU units` = fmt(units), `Share of ADU units` = pct(units / sum(adu$units)),
            `ADU projects` = fmt(projects), `Properties with an ADU` = fmt(properties),
            `Share of properties` = pct(properties / c1b_tot$properties), `Units completed` = fmt(completed),
            `Share completed` = pct(completed / units)) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("ADU units by property type, citywide, ", window_label, " (ADU units; ADU projects; properties)"),
      note = paste0("Shares are shares of ADU units; the share of properties is shown beside them because the two differ (a multi-family property more often adds several units). ",
                    "Definitions: property type is the parcel's land use class in the 2026 Assessor roll. Single-family = use type SFR. Multi-family = use type R-I (residential income), which is any lot with two or more units, so duplex lots count as multi-family. ",
                    "Other or unknown = condominium, commercial, vacant or other parcels, parcels with no roll record, and projects placed on no parcel. Grandfathered ADUs are all on single-family parcels. ",
                    "The class reflects the parcel in 2026, not at the permit date."),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 7)))
```

## CPA rankings

The first table ranks every CPA in the City on cumulative ADU units; the two tables after it follow the six candidate CPAs year by year.

```{r c2-rankings}
not_ranked <- c("Port of Los Angeles", "Los Angeles International Airport")
sf_den <- parcel_class %>% filter(land_use == "Single-family") %>% count(cpa, name = "sf_parcels")
band_bg <- function(r) case_when(r <= 5 ~ "#1F3864", r <= 10 ~ "#2E75B6", r <= 17 ~ "#BDD7EE", TRUE ~ "#E7E6E6")
band_fg <- function(r) if_else(r <= 10, "white", "black")
rank_cells <- function(df, value_fmt, rank_col, val_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(cell = cell_spec(paste0("#", .data[[rank_col]], " (", value_fmt(.data[[val_col]]), ")"),
                            background = band_bg(.data[[rank_col]]), color = band_fg(.data[[rank_col]]), bold = TRUE)) %>%
    select(cpa, issue_year, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = issue_year, values_from = cell) %>%
    arrange(match(cpa, focus_cpas)) %>% rename(CPA = cpa)
}
# The standings table and both rank tables, for one set of projects (all properties, or
# single-family properties only). The denominator is single-family parcels in both.
rank_build <- function(a, what, num_note) {
  a_rk <- a %>% filter(cpa %in% setdiff(cpa_sf$cpa, not_ranked))
  early <- a_rk %>% filter(is.na(issue_year) | issue_year < 2017) %>% count(cpa, wt = units, name = "early")   # older permitted and grandfathered
  rank_base <- a_rk %>% filter(!is.na(issue_year), issue_year >= 2017) %>%
    count(cpa, issue_year, wt = units, name = "units") %>%
    complete(cpa = setdiff(cpa_sf$cpa, not_ranked), issue_year = 2017:year(data_asof), fill = list(units = 0))
  n_ranked <- n_distinct(rank_base$cpa)
  annual <- rank_base %>% group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_n = min_rank(desc(units))) %>% ungroup()
  cumul <- rank_base %>% arrange(issue_year) %>% left_join(early, by = "cpa") %>%
    group_by(cpa) %>% mutate(cum_units = cumsum(units) + coalesce(early, 0)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(sf_den, by = "cpa") %>%
    mutate(per100 = 100 * cum_units / sf_parcels) %>%
    group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_pct = min_rank(desc(per100))) %>% ungroup()
  legend_note <- paste0("Annual ranks cover ADUs permitted in each year from 2017 on; cumulative counts start from the ADUs with an earlier permit year or none (older permitted and grandfathered). Cell = rank among ", n_ranked, " CPAs (value). Shading: dark blue = top 5, medium blue = 6-10, light blue = 11-17, grey = 18-", n_ranked,
                        ". Port of Los Angeles and Los Angeles International Airport are not ranked.")
  standings <- cumul %>% filter(issue_year == year(data_asof)) %>%
    mutate(rank_units = min_rank(desc(cum_units))) %>% arrange(rank_pct)
  t1 <- standings %>%
    transmute(`Rank (per 100 SF parcels)` = rank_pct, CPA = cpa, `ADU units` = fmt(cum_units),
              `Single-family parcels` = fmt(sf_parcels), `Units per 100 SF parcels` = fmt(per100, 1),
              `Rank (units)` = rank_units) %>%
    kable(format = "html", align = c("c", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c"),
          caption = paste0("Cumulative standings, all CPAs, ", what, ", ", window_label, " (ADU units; parcels)")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "striped"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(which(standings$cpa %in% focus_cpas), bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF2CC") %>%
    footnote(general = paste("Six candidate CPAs highlighted.", num_note), general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  t2 <- annual %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% rank_cells(fmt, "rank_n", "units") %>%
    kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = paste0("Rank by ADU units permitted each year, six candidate CPAs, ", what, " (ADU units)")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE) %>%
    footnote(general = legend_note, general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  t3 <- cumul %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% rank_cells(function(v) fmt(v, 1), "rank_pct", "per100") %>%
    kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = paste0("Rank by cumulative ADU units per 100 single-family parcels, through each year, six candidate CPAs, ", what)) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE) %>%
    footnote(general = paste(legend_note, "Denominator: parcels typed SFR in the 2026 Assessor roll, assigned to CPAs by interior point.", num_note),
             general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  list(standings = standings, n_ranked = n_ranked, html = paste(as.character(t1), as.character(t2), as.character(t3), sep = "\n"))
}
rk_all <- rank_build(adu, "all properties", "The numerator includes ADUs on multi-family parcels.")
rk_sf  <- rank_build(filter(adu, is_sfp), "single-family properties only",
                     "The numerator counts ADU units on single-family properties only, so both sides of the ratio count the same kind of lot.")
standings <- rk_all$standings; n_ranked <- rk_all$n_ranked
qa_add(7, "CPA rankings: single-family units do not exceed all units in any CPA", paste(n_ranked, "CPAs"),
       paste(sum(rk_sf$standings$cum_units[match(standings$cpa, rk_sf$standings$cpa)] <= standings$cum_units), "hold"),
       all(rk_sf$standings$cum_units[match(standings$cpa, rk_sf$standings$cpa)] <= standings$cum_units), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
sf_switch(rk_all$html, rk_sf$html)
```

## ADU units by CPA, mapped

Counts follow CPA size, so the map also offers two relative measures: each CPA's share of the City's ADU units, and its units per 100 single-family parcels.

```{r c3-prep}
cpa_map_sf <- cpa_sf %>% filter(!cpa %in% not_ranked)
cum_by_cpa <- adu %>% filter(cpa %in% cpa_map_sf$cpa) %>% group_by(cpa) %>%
  summarise(all_u = sum(units), comp_u = sum(units[status == "Completed"]),
            all_s = sum(units[is_sfp]), comp_s = sum(units[is_sfp & status == "Completed"]), .groups = "drop")
cpa_join <- cpa_map_sf %>% left_join(cum_by_cpa, by = "cpa") %>% mutate(across(c(all_u, comp_u, all_s, comp_s), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

```{r c3-shares}
city_units <- sum(adu$units); city_comp <- sum(adu$units[adu$status == "Completed"])
city_units_s <- sum(adu$units[adu$is_sfp]); city_comp_s <- sum(adu$units[adu$is_sfp & adu$status == "Completed"])
c3s <- cpa_join %>% left_join(sf_den, by = "cpa") %>%
  mutate(sh_all = all_u / city_units, sh_comp = comp_u / city_comp,
         p100_all = 100 * all_u / sf_parcels, p100_comp = 100 * comp_u / sf_parcels,
         sh_all_s = all_s / city_units_s, sh_comp_s = comp_s / city_comp_s,          # single-family versions
         p100_all_s = 100 * all_s / sf_parcels, p100_comp_s = 100 * comp_s / sf_parcels,
         done = ifelse(all_u > 0, comp_u / all_u, NA_real_))
chk_p100 <- c3s %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(cpa, p100_all) %>%
  inner_join(select(standings, cpa, per100), by = "cpa")
qa_add(7, "CPA units map: units per 100 single-family parcels match the CPA standings, every CPA",
       paste(nrow(c3s), "CPAs"), paste(sum(abs(chk_p100$p100_all - chk_p100$per100) < 1e-9), "match"),
       nrow(chk_p100) == nrow(c3s) && all(abs(chk_p100$p100_all - chk_p100$per100) < 1e-9), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, "CPA units map: CPA shares of City units sum to at most 100%", "<= 100%",
       pct(sum(c3s$sh_all)), sum(c3s$sh_all) <= 1 + 1e-9 && sum(c3s$sh_comp) <= 1 + 1e-9, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
nice_brks <- function(v, step) {      # six bins from quantiles, rounded to a readable step
  q <- unique(round(quantile(v, probs = seq(1/6, 5/6, length.out = 5), na.rm = TRUE) / step) * step)
  unique(c(0, q[q > 0], ceiling(max(v, na.rm = TRUE) / step) * step))
}
brk_n <- nice_brks(c(c3s$all_u, c3s$comp_u), 50)
pal_n <- colorBin("Greens", domain = range(brk_n), bins = brk_n, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
brk_sh <- nice_brks(c(c3s$sh_all, c3s$sh_comp), 0.005)
brk_100 <- nice_brks(c(c3s$p100_all, c3s$p100_comp), 1)
pal_sh <- colorBin("Blues", domain = range(brk_sh), bins = brk_sh, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
pal_100 <- colorBin("Purples", domain = range(brk_100), bins = brk_100, na.color = "#D9D9D9")
c3_ll <- c3s %>% st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 50) %>% to_ll(digits = 5)
nmc <- function(v) as.list(setNames(v, c3_ll$cpa))       # bins are shared by every status and by the single-family versions
c3_sel <- list(all = status_levels, comp = "Completed", prog = "In progress", stal = "Stalled")
c3_base <- adu %>% filter(cpa %in% cpa_map_sf$cpa)
cols_c3 <- list(); c3_sum <- 0
for (u in names(c3_sel)) for (pt in c("", "_s")) {
  dsel <- c3_base %>% filter(status %in% c3_sel[[u]], pt == "" | is_sfp) %>% count(cpa, wt = units, name = "v")
  v <- coalesce(dsel$v[match(c3_ll$cpa, dsel$cpa)], 0)
  tot <- sum(adu$units[adu$status %in% c3_sel[[u]] & (pt == "" | adu$is_sfp)])
  if (pt == "" && u != "all") c3_sum <- c3_sum + sum(v)
  cols_c3[[paste0("n_", u, pt)]] <- nmc(pal_n(v))
  cols_c3[[paste0("sh_", u, pt)]] <- nmc(pal_sh(pmin(v / max(tot, 1), max(brk_sh))))
  cols_c3[[paste0("p100_", u, pt)]] <- nmc(pal_100(100 * v / c3_ll$sf_parcels))
}
qa_add(7, "CPA units map: completed + in progress + stalled layers sum to all units on the map", fmt(sum(c3_ll$all_u)), fmt(c3_sum), c3_sum == sum(c3_ll$all_u), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
rk <- function(x) min_rank(desc(x))
lab_c3 <- sprintf(paste0("<b>%s</b><br>ADU units: %s, %s of the City's (rank %d of %d)<br>",
                         "Completed units: %s, %s of the City's completed (rank %d)<br>",
                         "Share of its own units completed: %s<br>",
                         "Units per 100 single-family parcels: %s all, %s completed (rank %d)<br>Single-family parcels: %s<br>",
                         "<i>On single-family properties only:</i> %s units (%s completed), %s of the City's; %s per 100 single-family parcels (rank %d)"),
                  c3_ll$cpa, fmt(c3_ll$all_u), pct(c3_ll$sh_all), rk(c3_ll$sh_all), nrow(c3_ll),
                  fmt(c3_ll$comp_u), pct(c3_ll$sh_comp), rk(c3_ll$sh_comp), pct(c3_ll$done),
                  fmt(c3_ll$p100_all, 1), fmt(c3_ll$p100_comp, 1), rk(c3_ll$p100_all), fmt(c3_ll$sf_parcels),
                  fmt(c3_ll$all_s), fmt(c3_ll$comp_s), pct(c3_ll$sh_all_s), fmt(c3_ll$p100_all_s, 1), rk(c3_ll$p100_all_s))
pct_fmt <- labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) round(100 * x, 1))
m_c3 <- leaflet_base(height = 620, bm_key = "city") %>% fit_to(cpa_map_sf) %>%
  addPolygons(data = c3_ll, layerId = ~cpa, fillColor = unname(cols_c3$n_all), fillOpacity = 0.75,
              color = "white", weight = 1, label = lapply(lab_c3, HTML), group = "c3") %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(filter(cpa_map_sf, cpa %in% focus_cpas), digits = 5), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.2,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_n, values = brk_n, title = "ADU units", opacity = 0.8,
            className = "info legend leg-n") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_sh, values = brk_sh, title = "Share of the City's<br>ADU units", opacity = 0.8,
            labFormat = pct_fmt, className = "info legend leg-sh") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal_100, values = brk_100, title = "ADU units per 100<br>single-family parcels", opacity = 0.8,
            className = "info legend leg-p100") %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id;
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Properties</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_p\" value=\"\" checked> All properties</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_p\" value=\"_s\"> Single-family only</label><br>' +
          '<b>Units</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"all\" checked> All ADU units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"comp\"> Completed</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"prog\"> In progress</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_u\" value=\"stal\"> Stalled</label><br>' +
          '<b>Measure</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"n\" checked> Counts of ADU units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"sh\"> Share of the City&#39;s units</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_m\" value=\"p100\"> Per 100 single-family parcels</label>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      function update() {
        var u = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_u\"]:checked').value;
        var ms = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_m\"]:checked').value;
        var pt = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_p\"]:checked').value;
        var cols = data.cols[ms + '_' + u + pt];
        Object.keys(cols).forEach(function(id) {
          var l = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id);
          if (l) l.setStyle({fillColor: cols[id]});
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-n').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'n' ? '' : 'none'; });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-sh').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'sh' ? '' : 'none'; });
        el.querySelectorAll('.leg-p100').forEach(function(d) { d.style.display = ms === 'p100' ? '' : 'none'; });
      }
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = list(cols = cols_c3))
qa_add(7, "CPA units map: unit counts on the map sum to the mapped CPAs' units", fmt(sum(cum_by_cpa$all_u)), fmt(sum(c3s$all_u)),
       sum(c3s$all_u) == sum(cum_by_cpa$all_u) && sum(c3s$comp_u) == sum(cum_by_cpa$comp_u), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
chk_p100s <- c3s %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(cpa, p100_all_s) %>% inner_join(select(rk_sf$standings, cpa, per100), by = "cpa")
qa_add(7, "CPA units map: single-family units per 100 single-family parcels match the single-family standings, every CPA",
       paste(nrow(c3s), "CPAs"), paste(sum(abs(chk_p100s$p100_all_s - chk_p100s$per100) < 1e-9), "match"),
       nrow(chk_p100s) == nrow(c3s) && all(abs(chk_p100s$p100_all_s - chk_p100s$per100) < 1e-9) && all(c3s$all_s <= c3s$all_u), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("ADU units by Community Plan Area, ", window_label))),
        m_c3,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Use the controls to switch between all and completed units, and between three measures: counts of ADU units, each CPA's share of the City's units, and units per 100 single-family parcels. Six candidate CPAs outlined in black; hover for every measure and rank. ",
                      "Shares are of all ", fmt(city_units), " ADU units (", fmt(city_comp), " completed) permitted citywide; Port of Los Angeles and Los Angeles International Airport are not mapped. ",
                      "Per 100 single-family parcels uses the same denominator as the CPA rankings: parcels typed SFR in the 2026 Assessor roll, assigned by interior point; the numerator includes ADUs on multi-family parcels. ",
                      "The Units control filters by status: all units, completed, in progress or stalled. Counts for every status share one set of color bins, so for in-progress and stalled units the share of the City's units shows the pattern more clearly. Choose \"Single-family only\" to count ADU units on single-family properties alone: the counts, the shares (of the City's ", fmt(city_units_s), " single-family ADU units; ", fmt(city_comp_s), " completed) and the per-100 measure each switch, on the same color bins. ",
                      "Completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC in the permit chain. Shared bins for all and completed units within each measure. ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

## ADU projects by issue year, mapped

```{r c4-year-slider}
# One point per project, drawn by issue year with a slider (cumulative or single year).
c4_years <- 2010:year(data_asof)
p4 <- adu_pts %>% filter(cpa %in% cpa_sf$cpa, issue_year %in% c4_years | is.na(issue_year)) %>% st_transform(crs_web)
xy4 <- st_coordinates(p4)
c4_data <- list(lat = round(xy4[, 2], 5), lng = round(xy4[, 1], 5),
                yr = coalesce(as.integer(p4$issue_year - min(c4_years)), -1L), st = as.integer(p4$status) - 1L, u = as.numeric(p4$units),
                sf = as.integer(p4$is_sfp),
                years = c4_years, cols = unname(pal_status), stat = names(pal_status),
                last_label = paste0(year(data_asof), " (to ", str_squish(format(data_asof, "%b %e")), ")"))
n_nopt <- nrow(adu) - nrow(p4)
qa_add(7, "Year-slider map: mapped projects + projects without a point = all projects", fmt(nrow(adu)),
       fmt(nrow(p4) + n_nopt), nrow(p4) > 0 && n_nopt >= 0 && !anyNA(c4_data$st) && !anyNA(c4_data$yr), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
c4_chk <- st_drop_geometry(p4) %>% count(issue_year, wt = units, name = "u") %>%
  inner_join(c1 %>% select(issue_year, units), by = "issue_year")
qa_add(7, "Year-slider map: units by issue year do not exceed the units by year table in any year", "all years",

# Working-class overlay (rule A + B + C), switched on from the layers control

wc_ov_sf <- tracts_sf %>% select(CT20) %>% inner_join(select(tract_class_city, CT20, class), by = "CT20") %>%

  addLegend("bottomleft", colors = unname(wc_cols), labels = names(wc_cols), title = "Tract class (A + B + C)", opacity = 0.8,

  hideGroup(wc_ov_group) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = unname(pal_status), labels = names(pal_status), title = "Status", opacity = 0.9) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id, n = data.lat.length, yrs = data.years, last = yrs.length - 1;
      var G = {};      // one layer group per issue year (-1 = no permit year), property type and status
      function grp(j, sf, st) { var key = j + '|' + sf + '|' + st; if (!G[key]) G[key] = {j: j, sf: sf, st: st, lg: L.layerGroup()}; return G[key].lg; }
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        L.circleMarker([data.lat[i], data.lng[i]], {radius: 1.7, stroke: false, fillColor: data.cols[data.st[i]],
                                                    fillOpacity: 0.75, interactive: false}).addTo(grp(data.yr[i], data.sf[i], data.st[i]));
      }
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px'; div.style.width = '250px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Issue year: <span class=\"c4-yr\"></span></b><br>' +
          '<input type=\"range\" class=\"c4-slider\" min=\"0\" max=\"' + last + '\" value=\"' + last + '\" step=\"1\" style=\"width: 100%;\">' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_mode\" value=\"cum\" checked> Through this year (cumulative)</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_mode\" value=\"one\"> Issued in this year only</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"c4-sf\"> Single-family properties only</label><br>' +
          '<b>Status</b> ' + data.stat.map(function(t, q) { return '<label style=\"margin-right: 6px;\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"c4-st c4-st' + q + '\" checked> <span style=\"color:' + data.cols[q] + '\">&#9679;</span> ' + t + '</label>'; }).join('') + '<br>' +
          '<button type=\"button\" class=\"c4-play\" style=\"margin: 4px 0;\">&#9654; Play</button>' +
          '<div class=\"c4-count\" style=\"margin-top: 2px;\"></div>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div); L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      var slider = el.querySelector('.c4-slider'), timer = null;
      function num(v) { return v.toLocaleString('en-US'); }
      function update() {
        var k = +slider.value;
        var cum = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_mode\"]:checked').value === 'cum';
        var sfOnly = el.querySelector('.c4-sf').checked;
        var stOn = data.stat.map(function(t, q) { return el.querySelector('.c4-st' + q).checked; });
        function show(g, on) { if (on) { if (!map.hasLayer(g)) map.addLayer(g); } else if (map.hasLayer(g)) map.removeLayer(g); }
        Object.keys(G).forEach(function(key) { var g = G[key]; show(g.lg, (cum ? g.j <= k : g.j === k) && (!sfOnly || g.sf) && stOn[g.st]); });
        var p = 0, u = 0, s = [0, 0, 0];
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var j = data.yr[i];
          if ((cum ? j <= k : j === k) && (!sfOnly || data.sf[i]) && stOn[data.st[i]]) { p++; u += data.u[i]; s[data.st[i]] += data.u[i]; }
        }
        var lab = k === last ? data.last_label : String(yrs[k]);
        el.querySelector('.c4-yr').textContent = (cum ? 'Through ' : '') + lab;
        el.querySelector('.c4-count').innerHTML = num(p) + ' ADUs, ' + num(u) + ' ADU units<br>' +
          data.stat.map(function(t, q) { return t + ': ' + num(s[q]); }).join(' &middot; ');
      }
      function stop() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; el.querySelector('.c4-play').innerHTML = '&#9654; Play'; } }
      el.querySelector('.c4-play').addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (timer) { stop(); return; }
        if (+slider.value >= last) slider.value = 0; else slider.value = +slider.value + 1;
        update();
        this.innerHTML = '&#10074;&#10074; Pause';
        timer = setInterval(function() {
          if (+slider.value >= last) { stop(); return; }
          slider.value = +slider.value + 1; update();
        }, 1100);
      });
      slider.addEventListener('input', function() { stop(); update(); });
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = c4_data)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("ADU projects in Los Angeles by issue year, ", window_label))),
        m_c4,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Drag the slider or press Play to watch ADU projects accumulate by the year their first ADU permit was issued; switch to \"Issued in this year only\" to see one year at a time. ",
                      "One dot per project at its parcel (", fmt(nrow(p4)), " projects; ", fmt(n_nopt), " more could not be placed on the map and are not drawn). ",
                      "Color is the project's status as of ", fmt_date(data_asof), ", not its status in the year shown; the counts in the control are ADU units by that status. ",
                      "Tick \"Single-family properties only\" to hide projects on every other property type, and untick a status to hide it; the counts follow. The slider runs from 2010: 2010 to 2016 are older permitted ADUs. Grandfathered ADUs have no permit year, so they appear in every cumulative view and in no single-year view. ",
                      "Grey lines: CPAs (hover for the name); black outline: six candidate CPAs. ",
                      "Tick \"Working-class tracts (A + B + C)\" at top left to shade every City tract by its class under the rule used in this analysis (working-class, other, or insufficient data) beneath the dots. ",
                      basemap_credit, ".")))
```

```{r stage7-cpa-helpers}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 7 (part 2). HELPERS FOR THE SIX CPA SUBSECTIONS (cpa_section.Rmd)
# =============================================================================
# ---- Dated bars, cumulative-unit charts ---------------------------------------------
dated_long <- function(d) {
  yrs <- 2017:year(data_asof)
  map_dfr(yrs, function(Y) {
    e <- yr_end(Y)
    inc <- d %>% filter(is.na(submitted) | submitted <= e)          # grandfathered ADUs have no dates: counted as completed from the first bar
    done <- is.na(inc$submitted) | (!is.na(inc$completion_dt) & inc$completion_dt <= e)
    sy <- year(inc$submitted)
    tibble(year = Y,
           Completed = sum(inc$units[done]),
           New = sum(inc$units[!done & sy == Y]),
           Ongoing = sum(inc$units[!done & sy < Y]))
  })
}
dated_chart <- function(d, title) {
  bars <- dated_long(d)
  long <- bars %>% pivot_longer(c(Completed, New, Ongoing), names_to = "segment", values_to = "units") %>%
    mutate(segment = factor(segment, levels = c("Completed", "New", "Ongoing")))
  yrs <- sort(unique(bars$year)); ymax <- max(rowSums(bars[, c("Completed", "New", "Ongoing")]), 1)
  frames <- map_dfr(yrs, function(F) long %>% filter(year <= F) %>% mutate(frame = F))
  totals <- bars %>% mutate(total = Completed + New + Ongoing, frame = year,
    label = sprintf("Through %s: %s units (completed %s, new %s, ongoing %s)",
                    ifelse(year == year(data_asof), paste0(format(data_asof, "%b %e, %Y") %>% str_squish()), year),
                    fmt(total), fmt(Completed), fmt(New), fmt(Ongoing)))
  ticktext <- ifelse(yrs == year(data_asof), paste0(yrs, "*"), as.character(yrs))
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_bars(data = frames, x = ~year, y = ~units, color = ~segment, colors = pal_dated, frame = ~frame,
             hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:,} units<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") %>%
    add_text(data = totals, x = 2016.6, y = ymax * 1.1, text = ~label, frame = ~frame,
             textposition = "middle right", showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "none", inherit = FALSE,
             textfont = list(size = 12)) %>%
    layout(barmode = "stack", title = list(text = title, x = 0),
           xaxis = list(title = "", tickvals = yrs, ticktext = ticktext, range = c(2016.4, max(yrs) + 0.6)),
           yaxis = list(title = "ADU units (cumulative)", range = c(0, ymax * 1.18), separatethousands = TRUE),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15)) %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 600, transition = 0, redraw = TRUE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Through ")) %>%
    animation_button(visible = FALSE) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  # Open on the latest year: show the last frame's data and park the slider there
  b <- plotly_build(p)
  last <- length(b$x$frames)
  for (k in seq_along(b$x$frames[[last]]$data)) {
    tr <- b$x$frames[[last]]$data[[k]]; idx <- b$x$frames[[last]]$traces[[k]] + 1
    for (nm in names(tr)) b$x$data[[idx]][[nm]] <- tr[[nm]]
  }
  if (length(b$x$layout$sliders)) b$x$layout$sliders[[1]]$active <- last - 1
  list(widget = b, bars = bars)
}

# ---- Measures formatting (community profile, working-class demographics): estimate and MOE in separate cells ----------
fmt_est <- function(type, est, low = FALSE) {
  out <- case_when(is.na(est) ~ "n/a",
                   type == "rate" ~ paste0(fmt(100 * est, 1), "%"),
                   type == "average" ~ paste0("$", fmt(est)),
                   TRUE ~ fmt(est))
  if_else(!is.na(low) & low, paste0(out, " †"), out)
}
fmt_moe <- function(type, est, moe) {
  case_when(is.na(est) | is.na(moe) ~ "n/a",
            type == "rate" ~ paste0("± ", fmt(100 * moe, 1), " pts"),
            type == "average" ~ paste0("± $", fmt(moe)),
            TRUE ~ paste0("± ", fmt(moe)))
}
d1_order <- c("Total population", "Total households", "Owner households", "Renter households",
  "Homeownership rate",

  "Owner households that moved in 2023 or later", "Share of owners that moved in 2023 or later",
  "Average household income",
  "Households with poverty status", "Households below poverty", "Household poverty rate",
  "Latino households", "Latino owner households", "Latino homeownership rate", "Latino share of owner households",
  "Black households", "Black owner households", "Black homeownership rate", "Black share of owner households",
  "Non-Hispanic white households", "Non-Hispanic white owner households", "Non-Hispanic white homeownership rate", "Non-Hispanic white share of owner households",
  "Average gross rent",
  "Renter households with a computed rent burden", "Rent-burdened households", "Rent-burden rate",
  "Severely rent-burdened households", "Severe rent-burden rate",
  "Total housing units", "Occupied housing units", "Vacant housing units", "Homeowner vacancy rate", "Rental vacancy rate",
  "Adults 25 and over", "Adults 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher", "Share of adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher")
# Community profile layout: one row per measure, with its count and, where the report computes

stopifnot(setequal(na.omit(c(d1_rows$count_key, d1_rows$share_key)), d1_order))   # every measure appears exactly once
d1_cells <- function(meas) {       # meas: one group's measures (measure, type, estimate, moe, low_reliability)
  pick <- function(key, what) {
    i <- match(key, meas$measure)
    case_when(is.na(key) ~ "—",
              what == "est" ~ fmt_est(meas$type[i], meas$estimate[i], meas$low_reliability[i]),
              TRUE ~ fmt_moe(meas$type[i], meas$estimate[i], meas$moe[i]))
  }
  tibble(Measure = d1_rows$label,
         Count = pick(d1_rows$count_key, "est"), `Count MOE` = pick(d1_rows$count_key, "moe"),
         Share = pick(d1_rows$share_key, "est"), `Share MOE` = pick(d1_rows$share_key, "moe"))
}
d1_note <- paste(
  "ACS 2020–2024 5-year estimates for the CPA's crosswalk tracts; counts summed across tracts, shares and averages recomputed from the sums. MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points, pts); † = low reliability (coefficient of variation over 30%); — = not applicable. CPA margins combine many tracts and are approximate.",
  "Count: people, households or housing units; the two averages are in dollars (average household income = aggregate household income ÷ households, 2024 dollars; average gross rent = aggregate gross rent ÷ renter units paying cash rent).",
  "Share: the row's count as a share of its base. Owner households ÷ all households (the homeownership rate); owners who moved in ÷ owner households; households below poverty ÷ households with poverty status determined; a group's owner households ÷ that group's households (the group's homeownership rate); a group's share of all owner households = its owner households ÷ all owner households; rent-burdened households ÷ renter households with a computed rent burden (rent-burdened: gross rent is 30% or more of household income; severely rent-burdened: 50% or more); adults with a bachelor's degree or higher ÷ adults 25 and over. The two vacancy rates have no single count.",
  "Black and Latino figures are reported separately and never summed. The Black table includes Black householders who are Latino, so it overlaps the Latino table slightly; the groups do not sum to all households.",
  "\"Moved in\" is the year the householder moved into the unit (B25038), not the purchase year; a 2020–2024 file understates \"2023 or later\".",
  "Averages run above medians when incomes are skewed, so CPA averages are not compared with the tract medians on the maps.",
  "Vacancy rates follow the Census Bureau's ACS Subject Definitions (Vacancy Status): vacant for sale ÷ (owner-occupied + vacant for sale + sold, not occupied); vacant for rent ÷ (renter-occupied + vacant for rent + rented, not occupied).",
  "Tables: B01003, B25038, B19025, B11001, B17017, B25003, B25003B/H/I, B25065, B25063, B25070, B25004, B15003, DP04.")

# ---- Working-class comparisons: demographics table and ADU table -------------------------------
wc_groups <- function(tc) {
  ok <- tc %>% filter(class != "Insufficient data")
  bind_rows(ok %>% transmute(GEOID, CT20, grp = paste0(class, ", all tracts")),
            ok %>% filter(!borderline) %>% transmute(GEOID, CT20, grp = paste0(class, ", without borderline")))
}
grp_levels <- c("Working-class, all tracts", "Other, all tracts", "Working-class, without borderline", "Other, without borderline")
d3_build <- function(tc) {
  g <- wc_groups(tc)
  long <- acs_long %>% select(-cpa) %>% inner_join(select(g, GEOID, grp), by = "GEOID", relationship = "many-to-many")
  meas <- if (nrow(long)) component_table(long, "grp") %>% build_measures() else tibble()
  ntr <- g %>% count(grp)
  list(meas = meas, ntr = ntr)
}
grp_note <- paste(
  "Columns: \"Working-class, all tracts\" = every tract classed working-class (tests A, B and C all pass). \"Other, all tracts\" = every tract with data that fails at least one test.",
  "\"Without borderline\" = the same two groups after dropping borderline tracts, those whose 90% interval for test A or B includes 50%, so their class could change with a different sample.",
  "Tracts with insufficient data (under 100 residents or no published median family income) get no class and are in no column.")
hl_up <- "#D9EAD3"; hl_down <- "#FFF2CC"      # working-class value above / below the other tracts' value
d3_table <- function(res, caption, note) {
  ntr <- setNames(res$ntr$n, res$ntr$grp); ntr <- coalesce(ntr[grp_levels], 0L); names(ntr) <- grp_levels
  m <- if (nrow(res$meas)) res$meas %>% filter(measure %in% d1_order) else
    tibble(group = character(), measure = character(), type = character(), estimate = numeric(), moe = numeric(), low_reliability = logical())
  cell <- function(gname, what) {
    d <- m[m$group == gname, ]; i <- match(d1_order, d$measure)
    if (ntr[[gname]] == 0) return(rep("no tracts", length(d1_order)))
    if (what == "est") fmt_est(d$type[i], d$estimate[i], d$low_reliability[i]) else fmt_moe(d$type[i], d$estimate[i], d$moe[i])
  }
  shade <- function(wc, oth) {     # rates and averages only, where the gap exceeds its 90% margin of error
    a <- m[m$group == wc, ]; b <- m[m$group == oth, ]
    ia <- match(d1_order, a$measure); ib <- match(d1_order, b$measure)
    if (ntr[[wc]] == 0 || ntr[[oth]] == 0) return(rep(NA_character_, length(d1_order)))
    diff <- a$estimate[ia] - b$estimate[ib]; me <- sqrt(a$moe[ia]^2 + b$moe[ib]^2)
    ok <- a$type[ia] %in% c("rate", "average") & is.finite(diff) & is.finite(me) & abs(diff) > me
    ifelse(ok & diff > 0, hl_up, ifelse(ok & diff < 0, hl_down, NA_character_))
  }
  out <- tibble(Measure = c("Census tracts", d1_order))
  pairs <- list(c(grp_levels[1], grp_levels[2]), c(grp_levels[3], grp_levels[4]))
  n_shaded <- 0
  for (pr in pairs) {
    sh <- shade(pr[1], pr[2]); n_shaded <- n_shaded + sum(!is.na(sh))
    est_wc <- cell(pr[1], "est")
    hit <- which(!is.na(sh))
    if (length(hit)) est_wc[hit] <- cell_spec(est_wc[hit], background = sh[hit], color = "black")
    out[[paste0(pr[1], "|est")]] <- c(fmt(ntr[[pr[1]]]), est_wc)
    out[[paste0(pr[1], "|moe")]] <- c("", cell(pr[1], "moe"))
    out[[paste0(pr[2], "|est")]] <- c(fmt(ntr[[pr[2]]]), cell(pr[2], "est"))
    out[[paste0(pr[2], "|moe")]] <- c("", cell(pr[2], "moe"))
  }
  hdr <- c(" " = 1, setNames(rep(2, 4), c(grp_levels[1], grp_levels[2], grp_levels[3], grp_levels[4])))
  kable(out, format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = caption,
        col.names = c("Measure", rep(c("Estimate", "MOE"), 4)), align = c("l", rep("r", 8))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    add_header_above(hdr) %>%
    footnote(general = paste(note, grp_note,
                             "Shading in the working-class columns marks shares and averages where working-class tracts differ from the other tracts in the same pair by more than the 90% margin of error of the difference: green = working-class tracts are higher, yellow = lower. Counts are not shaded, because they follow the number of tracts in each group."),
             general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE)
}
d4_build <- function(tc, adu_d, prop_d, sf_only = FALSE) {   # sf_only: single-family units over single-family eligible lots
  if (sf_only) { adu_d <- filter(adu_d, property_type == "Single-family"); prop_d <- mutate(prop_d, eligB = sfB, eligC = sfC) }
  g <- wc_groups(tc)
  map_dfr(grp_levels, function(gname) {
    ct <- g$CT20[g$grp == gname]
    a <- adu_d %>% filter(ct20 %in% ct); pr <- prop_d %>% filter(ct20 %in% ct)
    tibble(group = gname, tracts = length(ct), units = sum(a$units),
           completed = sum(a$units[a$status == "Completed"]), in_progress = sum(a$units[a$status == "In progress"]),
           stalled = sum(a$units[a$status == "Stalled"]),
           eligB = sum(pr$eligB), eligC = sum(pr$eligC), sf = sum(pr$is_sf),
           properties = n_distinct(a$prop_id))
  }) %>%
    mutate(per100B = 100 * units / eligB, per100C = 100 * units / eligC, per100sf = 100 * units / sf,
           share_completed = completed / units)
}
d4_table <- function(d4, sf_only = FALSE) {
  el <- if (sf_only) "single-family eligible lots" else "eligible lots"; un <- if (sf_only) "Single-family ADU units" else "ADU units"
  f <- function(x, d = 0) ifelse(is.finite(x), fmt(x, d), "n/a")
  p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), pct(x), "n/a")
  tibble(Measure = c("Census tracts", un, "Completed", "In progress", "Stalled",
                     paste0(un, " per 100 ", el, ", tier B"), paste0(un, " per 100 ", el, ", tier C"),
                     paste0(un, " per 100 single-family lots"), "Properties with ADUs", "Share of units completed")) %>%
    bind_cols(map_dfc(seq_len(nrow(d4)), function(i) {
      r <- d4[i, ]
      v <- if (r$tracts == 0) rep("no tracts", 10) else
        c(fmt(r$tracts), fmt(r$units), fmt(r$completed), fmt(r$in_progress), fmt(r$stalled),
          f(r$per100B, 1), f(r$per100C, 1), f(r$per100sf, 1), fmt(r$properties), p(r$share_completed))
      setNames(tibble(v), r$group)
    }))
}
# ---- Tract map data: one color scale per measure, shared
# by all six CPAs; grey where the group has under 50 households or the rate is
# flagged low reliability.
rate_cols <- function(num_v, den_v, nm) {
  w <- acs_long %>% filter(variable %in% c(num_v, den_v)) %>%
    select(GEOID, variable, estimate, moe) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = c(estimate, moe))
  ne <- w[[paste0("estimate_", num_v)]]; de <- w[[paste0("estimate_", den_v)]]
  nm_ <- w[[paste0("moe_", num_v)]]; dm <- w[[paste0("moe_", den_v)]]
  est <- ifelse(de > 0, ne / de, NA_real_)
  mo <- ifelse(de > 0, moe_prop(ne, de, nm_, dm), NA_real_)
  cv <- (mo / 1.645) / est
  out <- tibble(GEOID = w$GEOID, num = ne, den = de, est = est, moe = mo,
                grey = is.na(est) | de < 50 | (is.finite(cv) & cv > 0.30) | (est == 0 & de < 50))
  names(out)[-1] <- paste0(nm, "_", names(out)[-1])
  out
}
d2_tract <- rate_cols("B25038_002", "B25038_001", "own") %>%
  left_join(rate_cols("B25003B_002", "B25003B_001", "blk"), by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(rate_cols("B25003I_002", "B25003I_001", "lat"), by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(tract_class %>% select(GEOID, class_lab = class, borderline, share_no_ba, moe_ba, share_occ, moe_occ,
                                   mfi, mfi_ratio, test_A, test_B, test_C, estimate_pop,
                                   mhi, mhi_ratio, insufficient_hh, wc_hh), by = "GEOID") %>%
  # Income overlay and the county-median working-class option (protocol addendum 3.2 and 3.3)
  left_join(acs_long %>% filter(variable %in% c("B19113_001", "B19013_001")) %>% select(GEOID, variable, moe) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = moe) %>% transmute(GEOID, mfi_moe = B19113_001, mhi_moe = B19013_001), by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(class_hh = factor(case_when(insufficient_hh ~ "Insufficient data", wc_hh %in% TRUE ~ "Working-class", TRUE ~ "Other"), levels = names(wc_cols)),
         mfi_ratio_moe = mfi_moe / metro_mfi, mhi_ratio_moe = mhi_moe / county_mhi,      # the reference median is held fixed
         mfi_cross = !is.na(mfi_ratio) & !is.na(mfi_ratio_moe) & abs(mfi_ratio - 1) <= mfi_ratio_moe,
         mhi_cross = !is.na(mhi_ratio) & !is.na(mhi_ratio_moe) & abs(mhi_ratio - 1) <= mhi_ratio_moe) %>%
  # Homeownership change, 2015-2019 to 2020-2024, for the tract's group (protocol addendum 3.4)
  left_join(own_chg_tract %>% select(GEOID, chg_n20 = n20, chg_n10 = n10, matches("_(lat_own|blk_own|lat_shr|blk_shr|lat_rate|blk_rate)$")), by = "GEOID")

chg_col <- function(v, sig, breaks) ifelse(is.na(v), "#FFFFFF", ifelse(!(sig %in% TRUE), "#D9D9D9", chg_cols[findInterval(v, breaks) + 1]))

lay_sw <- function(col, lab) sprintf('<div><span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;background:%s;border:1px solid #999;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle;"></span>%s</div>', col, lab)
lay_ramp <- function(pal, vals, labs, title) paste0("<b>", title, "</b>", paste(lay_sw(pal(vals), labs), collapse = ""))
lay_rate_leg <- function(var, title, grey = TRUE) {
  dom <- d2_domain[[var]]; brk <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8); brk <- brk[brk >= dom[1] & brk <= dom[2]]
  paste0(lay_ramp(d2_pal[[var]], brk, paste0(round(100 * brk), "%"), title),
         if (grey) lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Under 50 households or unreliable") else "")
}
lay_cnt_leg <- function(var, title) {
  v <- round(lay_cnt_max[[var]] * c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), -1)
  lay_ramp(lay_cnt_pal[[var]], v, fmt(v), title)
}

  own = lay_rate_leg("own", "Homeownership rate", grey = FALSE), lat = lay_rate_leg("lat", "Latino homeownership rate"),
  blk = lay_rate_leg("blk", "Black homeownership rate"),
  hil = lay_hi_leg("Latino"), hib = lay_hi_leg("Black"),
  wc = paste0("<b>Tract class</b>", paste(lay_sw(wc_cols, names(wc_cols)), collapse = "")),

               paste(lay_sw(wc_cols, names(wc_cols)), collapse = "")),
  incm = paste0("<b>Tract median family income &divide; metro median ($", fmt(metro_mfi), ")</b>", paste(lay_sw(inc_cols, inc_labs), collapse = ""),
                lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Not published"), "<span style='font-size:11px'>Dashed outline: 90% range crosses 1.00</span>"),

  dbo = paste0("<b>Change in Black owner households</b><br><span style='font-size:11px'>2015&ndash;2019 to 2020&ndash;2024</span>", paste(lay_sw(chg_cols, chg_n_labs), collapse = ""), lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Within the margin of error")),
  dls = paste0("<b>Change in the Latino share of owners</b><br><span style='font-size:11px'>Percentage points, 2015&ndash;2019 to 2020&ndash;2024</span>", paste(lay_sw(chg_cols, chg_s_labs), collapse = ""), lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Within the margin of error"), lay_sw("#FFFFFF", "No owner households in a period")),

  dbr = paste0("<b>Change in the Black homeownership rate</b><br><span style='font-size:11px'>Percentage points, 2015&ndash;2019 to 2020&ndash;2024; colored = larger than the margin of error</span>", paste(lay_sw(chg_cols, chg_s_labs), collapse = ""), lay_sw("#D9D9D9", "Within the margin of error"), lay_sw("#FFFFFF", "No Black households in a period")),

  none = "")
lay_js <- "
  function(el, x, data) {
    var map = this;
    var layers = [['latn', 'Latino owner households (count)'], ['blkn', 'Black owner households (count)'],
                  ['own', 'Homeownership rate'], ['lat', 'Latino homeownership rate'], ['blk', 'Black homeownership rate'],
                  ['hil', 'Overall and Latino homeownership 50%+'], ['hib', 'Overall and Black homeownership 50%+'],
                  ['wc', 'Working-class tracts'], ['wch', 'Working-class tracts, county-median option'],
                  ['incm', 'Family income vs metro median'], ['inch', 'Household income vs county median'],
                  ['dlr', 'Change in Latino homeownership rate (significant changes)'], ['dbr', 'Change in Black homeownership rate (significant changes)'],
                  ['dlo', 'Change in Latino owner households'], ['dbo', 'Change in Black owner households'],
                  ['dls', 'Change in Latino share of owners'], ['dbs', 'Change in Black share of owners'],
                  ['none', 'No shading (outlines only)']];
    var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
    ctrl.onAdd = function() {
      var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
      div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px'; div.style.maxWidth = '270px';
      var h = '<b>Shade tracts by</b><br><select class=\"ly\" style=\"max-width:100%\">';
      layers.forEach(function(l) { h += '<option value=\"' + l[0] + '\">' + l[1] + '</option>'; });
      h += '</select>';
      div.innerHTML = h; L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div); L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
      return div;
    };
    ctrl.addTo(map);
    var leg = L.control({position: 'bottomright'});
    leg.onAdd = function() { var d = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'info legend'); d.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)'; d.style.padding = '6px 8px'; d.style.fontSize = '12px'; d.style.lineHeight = '18px'; return d; };
    leg.addTo(map);
    function update() {
      var ly = el.querySelector('select.ly').value;
      var c = data.cols[ly], dz = (data.dash || {})[ly] || {};      // dz: tracts drawn with a dashed outline in this layer
      Object.keys(c).forEach(function(id) {
        var l = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id);
        if (l) l.setStyle({fillColor: c[id], fillOpacity: ly === 'none' ? 0.02 : 0.72, dashArray: dz[id] ? '6,4' : null,
                           weight: dz[id] ? 2.4 : 0.7, color: dz[id] ? '#111111' : '#555555'});
      });
      leg.getContainer().innerHTML = data.legends[ly]; leg.getContainer().style.display = data.legends[ly] ? '' : 'none';
    }
    el.querySelector('select.ly').addEventListener('change', update);
    update();
  }"

# ---- Homeownership change table (protocol addendum 3.4) ---------------------------
own_chg_note <- paste("Tables B25003, B25003B (Black alone) and B25003I (Hispanic or Latino). Share of the group who own = the group's owner households ÷ the group's households; group share of owners = the group's owner households ÷ all owner households.",
                      "Change = 2020–2024 less 2015–2019; shares change in percentage points. The margin of a change is the square root of the two periods' squared margins, after the Census formula for a derived proportion in each period.",
                      "* = the change is larger than its 90% margin of error; other changes are within it and should be read as no measurable change. The two periods do not overlap.")
own_chg_table <- function(d, caption, note) {
  ord <- c("hh", "own", "own_rate", "blk_hh", "blk_own", "blk_rate", "blk_shr", "lat_hh", "lat_own", "lat_rate", "lat_shr")
  d <- d %>% arrange(match(key, ord))
  fe <- function(t, e) ifelse(is.na(e), "n/a", ifelse(t == "count", fmt(e), paste0(fmt(100 * e, 1), "%")))
  fm <- function(t, m) ifelse(is.na(m), "n/a", ifelse(t == "count", paste0("± ", fmt(m)), paste0("± ", fmt(100 * m, 1))))
  fc <- function(t, c, s) ifelse(is.na(c), "n/a", paste0(ifelse(c > 0, "+", ""), ifelse(t == "count", fmt(c), paste0(fmt(100 * c, 1), " pts")), ifelse(s, "*", "")))
  k <- d %>% transmute(Measure = measure, `2015–2019` = fe(type, est19), MOE = fm(type, moe19), `2020–2024` = fe(type, est24),
                       `MOE ` = fm(type, moe24), Change = fc(type, chg, sig), `MOE of change` = fm(type, chg_moe)) %>%
    kable(format = "html", caption = caption, align = c("l", rep("r", 6))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    pack_rows("All households", 1, 3) %>% pack_rows("Black households", 4, 7) %>% pack_rows("Latino households", 8, 11) %>%
    row_spec(which(d$sig), bold = TRUE) %>%
    footnote(general = note, general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE)
  k
}
```

# Decision points

This section sets out the four choices that shape the analysis, in the order they build on each other, and then the six candidates side by side. Each table below reflects the choices made above it: use the controls to change a choice and every table after it updates.

**The CPA sections earlier in the report use the option each control opens on: the first option of controls 1, 2 and 4, and tier B (the 4,500 sq ft floor) for control 3.** Tier A, the 4,000 sq ft floor, is listed first because it is the widest; it does not become the working definition until the team adopts it.

```{r stage8-decision-data}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 8. DECISION POINTS
# Every combination of the four choices (2 x 2 x 4 x 3 = 48) is computed here in
# R; the page only shows or hides the finished tables. Nothing is computed in
# the browser. The option each control opens on (dp_default) reproduces the CPA sections.
# =============================================================================
dp_opts <- list(
  t1 = c(all = "All ADUs: LADBS permitted, older permitted and grandfathered", ladbs = "LADBS permitted ADUs only (2017 to present)"),
  t2 = c(sfmf = "Single-family and multi-family", sf = "Single-family only"),
  t3 = c(A = "Tier A: 4,000 sq ft +", B = "Tier B: 4,500 sq ft +", C = "Tier C: B less hillside-fire lots", D = "Tier D: A less hillside-fire lots, no exemption"),
  t4 = c(occ = "A + B + C (occupation)", ind = "Industry in place of occupation", hh = "Household income against the county median"))
dp_default <- c(t1 = "all", t2 = "sfmf", t3 = "B", t4 = "occ")
tiers <- names(dp_opts$t3)
pr <- st_drop_geometry(prop_sf) %>%
  mutate(in_tract = !is.na(tract_cpa) & tract_cpa == cpa, older = older_adu %in% TRUE)
ad <- adu_focus %>%
  mutate(in_tract = !is.na(tract_cpa) & tract_cpa == cpa, status = as.character(status))
stopifnot(all(pr$is_sf[pr$older]))                      # Grandfathered ADUs sit on single-family parcels only
# Tract class under each working-class rule
tc_rules <- tract_class %>%
  transmute(CT20, cpa,
            occ = case_when(insufficient ~ NA, TRUE ~ wc_rec),
            ind = case_when(insufficient ~ NA, TRUE ~ wc_ind),
            hh  = case_when(insufficient_hh ~ NA, TRUE ~ wc_hh))
# Building blocks
lots_in  <- function(d, t2) d$is_sf | (t2 == "sfmf" & d$is_mf)
tier_in  <- function(d, t3) switch(t3, A = d$big4, B = d$big45, C = d$big45 & !d$hillside_fire, D = d$big4 & !d$hf_all)   # lot passes the tier
elig_in  <- function(d, t2, t3) lots_in(d, t2) & tier_in(d, t3)
adu_in_u <- function(a, t2) if (t2 == "sf") a$property_type == "Single-family" else rep(TRUE, nrow(a))
out_tier <- function(a, t2, t3) {          # units on lots the tier leaves out
  o <- a[[paste0("outside_", t3)]]
  if (t2 == "sf") o & a$property_type == "Single-family" else o
}
# One CPA (or tract subset) under one set of choices
dp_counts <- function(p, a, t1, t2, t3) {
  u <- adu_in_u(a, t2) & (t1 == "all" | a$source_tag == tag_levels[1])      # every ADU row carries its tag
  tibble(lots = sum(lots_in(p, t2)), sf_lots = sum(p$is_sf), elig = sum(elig_in(p, t2, t3)),
         units = sum(a$units[u]), completed = sum(a$units[u & a$status == "Completed"]),
         in_progress = sum(a$units[u & a$status == "In progress"]), stalled = sum(a$units[u & a$status == "Stalled"]),
         older = sum(a$units[u & a$source_tag == tag_levels[3]]),
         outside = sum(a$units[u & out_tier(a, t2, t3)]))
}
dp_wc <- function(cc, t1, t2, t3, t4) {     # working-class split for one CPA (cc = NULL pools all six)
  p <- pr %>% filter(in_tract); a <- ad %>% filter(in_tract); tc <- tc_rules
  if (!is.null(cc)) { p <- filter(p, cpa == cc); a <- filter(a, cpa == cc); tc <- filter(tc, cpa == cc) }
  wc_ct <- tc$CT20[tc[[t4]] %in% TRUE]; ot_ct <- tc$CT20[tc[[t4]] %in% FALSE]
  w <- dp_counts(filter(p, ct20 %in% wc_ct), filter(a, ct20 %in% wc_ct), t1, t2, t3)
  o <- dp_counts(filter(p, ct20 %in% ot_ct), filter(a, ct20 %in% ot_ct), t1, t2, t3)
  al <- dp_counts(p, a, t1, t2, t3)
  tibble(wc_tracts = length(wc_ct), ot_tracts = length(ot_ct), no_class = sum(is.na(tc[[t4]])),
         wc_elig = w$elig, wc_units = w$units, ot_units = o$units, units_in_tracts = al$units,
         wc_share = w$units / al$units, wc_per100 = 100 * w$units / w$elig, ot_per100 = 100 * o$units / o$elig)
}
cpa_counts <- function(cc, t1, t2, t3) dp_counts(filter(pr, cpa == cc), filter(ad, cpa == cc), t1, t2, t3)

# ---- Checks: the first option of every choice reproduces the CPA sections -----
for (cc in focus_cpas) {
  dd <- lapply(setNames(tiers, tiers), function(tt) cpa_counts(cc, "all", "sfmf", tt)); d <- dd$B
  l <- land_tbl[land_tbl$cpa == cc, ]; a <- adu_tbl[adu_tbl$cpa == cc, ]
  ok <- all(sapply(tiers, function(tt) dd[[tt]]$elig == l[[paste0("e", tt)]] && dd[[tt]]$outside == a[[paste0("outside_", tt)]])) &&
    d$units == a$units && d$completed == a$completed && d$in_progress == a$in_progress && d$stalled == a$stalled
  qa_add(8, paste0("Decision points, default choices reproduce the CPA land use summary and ADU units by status (eligible lots and units outside each of the four tiers, units, statuses), ", cc),
         "equal", if (ok) "equal" else "differs", ok, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  wS <- dp_wc(cc, "all", "sf", "B", "occ")       # single-family units over single-family eligible lots (addendum 2.4)
  gS <- d4_build(filter(tract_class, cpa == cc), filter(adu_focus, cpa == cc, tract_cpa %in% cc),
                 st_drop_geometry(prop_sf) %>% filter(cpa == cc, tract_cpa %in% cc), sf_only = TRUE)
  gS <- gS[gS$group == "Working-class, all tracts", ]
  qa_add(8, paste0("Decision points, single-family only reproduces the CPA single-family table of ADUs in working-class tracts (units, units per 100 single-family eligible lots), ", cc),
         "equal", if (wS$wc_units == gS$units && isTRUE(all.equal(wS$wc_per100, gS$per100B))) "equal" else "differs",
         wS$wc_units == gS$units && isTRUE(all.equal(wS$wc_per100, gS$per100B)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  w <- dp_wc(cc, "all", "sfmf", "B", "occ")
  d4c <- d4_build(filter(tract_class, cpa == cc), filter(adu_focus, cpa == cc, tract_cpa %in% cc),
                  st_drop_geometry(prop_sf) %>% filter(cpa == cc, tract_cpa %in% cc))
  g <- d4c[d4c$group == "Working-class, all tracts", ]
  ok <- w$wc_tracts == store[[cc]]$n_wc && w$wc_units == g$units && isTRUE(all.equal(w$wc_per100, g$per100B)) &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(w$wc_share, store[[cc]]$wc_units_share))
  qa_add(8, paste0("Decision points, default choices reproduce the CPA table of ADUs in working-class and other tracts (working-class tracts, units, units per 100 eligible lots), ", cc),
         "equal", if (ok) "equal" else "differs", ok, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
grid <- expand.grid(t1 = names(dp_opts$t1), t2 = names(dp_opts$t2), t3 = names(dp_opts$t3), cc = focus_cpas, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
all_states <- pmap_dfr(grid, function(t1, t2, t3, cc) cpa_counts(cc, t1, t2, t3) %>% mutate(t1 = t1, t2 = t2, t3 = t3, cpa = cc))
wide <- all_states %>% select(cpa, t1, t2, t3, elig, units, lots) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(t1, t2, t3), values_from = c(elig, units, lots))
ok_order <- with(wide, all(elig_all_sfmf_B <= elig_all_sfmf_A) && all(elig_all_sfmf_C <= elig_all_sfmf_B) &&
                   all(elig_all_sfmf_D <= elig_all_sfmf_A) && all(elig_all_sf_A <= elig_all_sfmf_A) &&
                   all(units_all_sf_A <= units_all_sfmf_A) && all(units_all_sfmf_A >= units_ladbs_sfmf_A) &&
                   all(lots_all_sf_A <= lots_all_sfmf_A))
qa_add(8, "Decision points: tier C <= tier B <= tier A, tier D <= tier A, single-family only <= single-family and multi-family, all ADUs >= LADBS permitted only, every CPA",
       "holds", if (ok_order) "holds" else "violated", ok_order, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(8, "Decision points: every state adds up (completed + in progress + stalled = units)", "all states",
       paste(sum(with(all_states, completed + in_progress + stalled == units)), "of", nrow(all_states)),
       all(with(all_states, completed + in_progress + stalled == units)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)

# ---- Grandfathered ADUs: what the permit record shows -------------------
# Cached in data/derived; rebuilt from the two LADBS files when missing or on refresh.
f_older_hist <- file.path(dir_derived, "older_adu_permit_history.csv")
older_ains <- parcel_class %>% filter(older_adu %in% TRUE) %>% select(AIN, cpa)
older_cached <- if (file.exists(f_older_hist)) read_csv(f_older_hist, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))$AIN else character(0)
if (params$refresh || !setequal(older_cached, older_ains$AIN)) {     # rebuilt when the set of Assessor-only parcels changes
  rd <- function(p) read_csv(p, col_select = c("APN", "USE_DESC", "ISSUE_DATE", "COFO_DATE", "ADU_CHANGED", "JUNIOR_ADU", "STATUS_DESC", "WORK_DESC"),
                             col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE)
  h <- bind_rows(rd(params$path_permits_2010s), rd(params$path_permits_2020s)) %>%
    mutate(apn = str_remove_all(coalesce(APN, ""), "[^0-9]")) %>% filter(apn %in% older_ains$AIN) %>%
    mutate(tagged = (coalesce(as_num(ADU_CHANGED), 0) + coalesce(as_num(JUNIOR_ADU), 0)) != 0 |
             USE_DESC %in% c("Accessory Dwelling Unit", "Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit"),
           named = str_detect(toupper(coalesce(WORK_DESC, "")), "ADU|ACCESSORY DWELLING|SECOND DWELLING|2ND DWELLING|SECOND UNIT|2ND UNIT"),
           done = STATUS_DESC %in% completed_statuses | !is.na(mdy_(COFO_DATE)))
  hist <- h %>% group_by(apn) %>%
    summarise(any_tagged = any(tagged), any_named = any(named), done_adu = any((tagged | named) & done), .groups = "drop")
  older_ains %>% left_join(hist, by = c("AIN" = "apn")) %>%
    mutate(history = case_when(any_tagged %in% TRUE ~ "ADU-tagged permit, not counted as a project",
                               any_named %in% TRUE ~ "Permit text names an ADU or second unit, no tag",
                               !is.na(any_tagged) ~ "Other permits only",
                               TRUE ~ "No permit, 2010 to 2026"),
           done_adu = coalesce(done_adu, FALSE)) %>%
    select(AIN, cpa, history, done_adu) %>% write_csv(f_older_hist)
  rm(h, hist); invisible(gc())
}
older_hist <- read_csv(f_older_hist, col_types = cols(AIN = "c", cpa = "c", history = "c", done_adu = "l"))
qa_add(8, "Grandfathered ADUs: permit history covers every such parcel", fmt(nrow(older_ains)), fmt(nrow(older_hist)),
       setequal(older_hist$AIN, older_ains$AIN), stop_if_fail = TRUE)

c6_proj <- adu %>% filter(prop_id %in% c6$AIN) %>% group_by(prop_id) %>% summarise(done = any(status == "Completed"), .groups = "drop")

                 "Other permits only", "No permit, 2010 to 2026")

# ---- HTML helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
dp_html <- function(df, caption, note = NULL, align = NULL, header = NULL, bold_rows = NULL, col.names = NA) {
  k <- kable(df, format = "html", caption = caption, align = align, col.names = col.names, escape = TRUE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 13)
  if (!is.null(header)) k <- add_header_above(k, header)
  if (!is.null(bold_rows)) k <- row_spec(k, bold_rows, bold = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(note)) k <- footnote(k, general = note, general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE)
  as.character(k)
}
dp_view <- function(html, ...) {            # wrap one finished table with the choices it belongs to
  st <- list(...)
  attrs <- paste(sprintf('data-%s="%s"', names(st), unlist(st)), collapse = " ")
  first <- all(mapply(function(k, v) v == dp_default[[k]], names(st), unlist(st)))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="dp-view" %s%s>\n%s\n</div>\n', attrs, if (first) "" else ' style="display: none;"', html))
}
dp_state_line <- function(keys) cat(sprintf('<p style="font-size: 13px;"><b>Choices applied here:</b> <span class="dp-state" data-keys="%s"></span></p>\n', paste(keys, collapse = ",")))
short <- unname(short_cpa[focus_cpas])
```
