```{r dp-controls, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
grp <- function(k, title) paste0(
  '<div style="display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; margin: 0 18px 4px 0;"><b>', title, '</b><br>',
  paste(sprintf('<label style="font-weight: normal; margin: 0;"><input type="radio" name="dp_%s" value="%s"%s> %s</label>',
                k, names(dp_opts[[k]]), ifelse(names(dp_opts[[k]]) == dp_default[[k]], " checked", ""), dp_opts[[k]]), collapse = "<br>"),
  '</div>')
cat('<div id="dp-controls" style="position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 500; background: #F4F6F8; border: 1px solid #C9D1D9; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; margin: 10px 0 16px 0; font-size: 13px;">',
    grp("t1", "1. ADUs counted"), grp("t2", "2. Parcels considered"), grp("t3", "3. Eligibility"), grp("t4", "4. Working-class rule"),
    '</div>\n', sep = "")
```

## 1. What counts as an ADU

The report counts three groups of ADUs together: LADBS permitted ADUs from 2017 to the present, older permitted ADUs from 2010 to 2016, and grandfathered ADUs that the Assessor's 2026 roll records on single-family parcels with no permit found (`r fmt(sum(pr$older))` in the six CPAs, `r fmt(nrow(older_ains))` citywide). The table of ADUs by tag under [ADU identification](#adu-identification) shows each group in each CPA. This control sets the second and third groups aside, to show how much they move the figures.

A grandfathered ADU counts as one **completed** unit. The roll records improvements that exist, and where both sources cover a parcel they agree: of the `r fmt(nrow(c6_proj))` Assessor-coded parcels citywide that do hold a permitted project, `r pct(mean(c6_proj$done))` have a completed one. The remaining `r fmt(sum(!c6_proj$done))` hold projects the permit record shows as stalled or in progress, which suggests some ADUs are built and assessed without a final sign-off. The second table shows what the City's permit files hold for each grandfathered parcel.

```{r dp-part1, results='asis'}
p1 <- map_dfr(focus_cpas, function(cc) { d <- cpa_counts(cc, "ladbs", "sfmf", "B"); o <- cpa_counts(cc, "all", "sfmf", "B"); a <- filter(ad, cpa == cc)
  tibble(CPA = cc, units = d$units, completed = d$completed, in_progress = d$in_progress, stalled = d$stalled,
         older_permit = sum(a$units[a$source_tag == tag_levels[2]]), older = o$older, total = o$units, completed_with = o$completed) })
p1 <- bind_rows(p1, p1 %>% summarise(across(-CPA, sum)) %>% mutate(CPA = "All six CPAs"))
qa_add(8, "Decision 1: LADBS permitted + older permitted + grandfathered = all ADU units, six CPAs", fmt(sum(adu_focus$units)),
       fmt(p1$total[7]), p1$total[7] == sum(adu_focus$units) && all(p1$units + p1$older_permit + p1$older == p1$total), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
cat(dp_html(p1 %>% transmute(CPA, `LADBS permitted ADU units` = fmt(units), Completed = fmt(completed), `In progress` = fmt(in_progress),
                             Stalled = fmt(stalled), `Older permitted ADU units` = fmt(older_permit), `Grandfathered ADUs` = fmt(older), `All ADU units` = fmt(total),
                             `Added by the two other groups` = pct((total - units) / units), `Completed, all ADUs` = fmt(completed_with)),
            caption = "Decision 1. ADU units by group, six candidate CPAs (ADU units)",
            note = paste0("LADBS permitted: ", ladbs_window, ", all property types. Older permitted: first ADU permit issued 2010 to 2016. Grandfathered: single-family parcels whose Assessor use code records an ADU (fourth character 6) and that hold no permitted ADU; one completed unit each. This table does not change with the controls."),
            align = c("l", rep("r", 9)), bold_rows = nrow(p1)))
h6 <- older_hist %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>% mutate(history = factor(history, levels = hist_levels))
ph <- bind_rows(h6 %>% count(cpa, history, .drop = FALSE) %>% mutate(cpa = as.character(cpa)),
                h6 %>% count(history, .drop = FALSE) %>% mutate(cpa = "All six CPAs"),
                older_hist %>% mutate(history = factor(history, levels = hist_levels)) %>% count(history, .drop = FALSE) %>% mutate(cpa = "Citywide")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = history, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(match(cpa, c(focus_cpas, "All six CPAs", "Citywide")))
done_n <- c(map_int(focus_cpas, ~ sum(older_hist$done_adu[older_hist$cpa == .x])),
            sum(older_hist$done_adu[older_hist$cpa %in% focus_cpas]), sum(older_hist$done_adu))
ph <- ph %>% mutate(Parcels = rowSums(across(all_of(hist_levels))), `of which an ADU permit shows completion` = done_n) %>%
  select(CPA = cpa, Parcels, all_of(hist_levels), `of which an ADU permit shows completion`)
qa_add(8, "Decision 1: permit-history rows sum to the Grandfathered ADU count, six CPAs", fmt(sum(pr$older)),
       fmt(ph$Parcels[ph$CPA == "All six CPAs"]), ph$Parcels[ph$CPA == "All six CPAs"] == sum(pr$older), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
cat(dp_html(ph, caption = "Grandfathered ADUs: what the City's permit files hold for the parcel (parcels)",
            note = "Permits matched to the parcel by APN in the two LADBS datasets (2010 to 2026). ADU-tagged permit, not counted as a project: the parcel has a permit with an ADU tag or ADU use type, but the project netted to zero units, was dropped as not active, or was placed on another parcel. Permit text names an ADU or second unit: no tag, so the identification steps do not pick it up; many predate 2017. Last column: an ADU-tagged or ADU-named permit on the parcel has a certificate of occupancy, final inspection or certificate of completion.",
            align = c("l", rep("r", 6)), bold_rows = c(nrow(ph) - 1, nrow(ph))))
```

## 2. Which parcels to consider

The choice is whether the analysis covers ADUs on single-family lots only, or on single-family and multi-family lots. The table shows how much of each CPA's ADU activity sits on multi-family lots.

```{r dp-part2, results='asis'}
dp_state_line("t1")
for (t1 in names(dp_opts$t1)) {
  p2 <- map_dfr(focus_cpas, function(cc) {
    p <- filter(pr, cpa == cc); a <- filter(ad, cpa == cc, t1 == "all" | source_tag == tag_levels[1]); n_old <- 0
    tibble(CPA = cc, sf_lots = sum(p$is_sf), mf_lots = sum(p$is_mf),
           sf_with = n_distinct(a$prop_id[a$property_type == "Single-family"]) + n_old,
           mf_with = n_distinct(a$prop_id[a$property_type == "Multi-family" & !is.na(a$prop_id)]),
           sf_units = sum(a$units[a$property_type == "Single-family"]) + n_old,
           mf_units = sum(a$units[a$property_type == "Multi-family"]),
           other_units = sum(a$units[!a$property_type %in% c("Single-family", "Multi-family")])) })
  p2 <- bind_rows(p2, p2 %>% summarise(across(-CPA, sum)) %>% mutate(CPA = "All six CPAs"))
  if (t1 == "all") qa_add(8, "Decision 2: units on single-family and multi-family properties match the CPA property-type tables, six CPAs",
                             paste(fmt(sum(adu_tbl$units_sf)), fmt(sum(adu_tbl$units_mf)), sep = " / "),
                             paste(fmt(p2$sf_units[7]), fmt(p2$mf_units[7]), sep = " / "),
                             p2$sf_units[7] == sum(adu_tbl$units_sf) && p2$mf_units[7] == sum(adu_tbl$units_mf), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  dp_view(dp_html(p2 %>% transmute(CPA, `Single-family lots` = fmt(sf_lots), `Multi-family lots` = fmt(mf_lots),
                                   `Single-family lots with an ADU` = fmt(sf_with), `Multi-family lots with an ADU` = fmt(mf_with),
                                   `Share of multi-family lots with an ADU` = pct(mf_with / mf_lots),
                                   `ADU units on single-family lots` = fmt(sf_units), `ADU units on multi-family lots` = fmt(mf_units),
                                   `Multi-family share of those units` = pct(mf_units / (sf_units + mf_units)),
                                   `ADU units on other or unplaced parcels` = fmt(other_units)),
                  caption = "Decision 2. ADUs on single-family and multi-family lots, six candidate CPAs (lots; ADU units)",
                  note = "Lots with an ADU: parcels with at least one ADU project. Multi-family share: units on multi-family lots ÷ units on single-family and multi-family lots. Units on other or unplaced parcels (condominium, commercial and other parcels, and projects placed on no parcel) are counted with \"single-family and multi-family\" in the tables below, as in the CPA sections, and dropped under \"single-family only\".",
                  align = c("l", rep("r", 9)), bold_rows = 7), t1 = t1)
}
```

## 3. Which definition of ADU-eligible

There are now four tiers, built from two choices: the lot floor (4,000 or 4,500 sq ft) and the hillside-fire screen (none, the ordinance's screen with its two exempt CPAs, or a screen with no exemption). Tiers B and C are the two the report has used so far, under their earlier names A and B.

The hillside-fire rule removes lots that lie in both a Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone and a Hillside Area. That rule is not enforced as written: since December 30, 2024 the City has not applied it to the ADUs state law requires it to approve, and the rule is being rewritten (see the hillside-fire flag under [Parcels and land use definitions](#parcels-and-land-use-definitions)). A lot tiers C and D remove can therefore still get an ADU, so the choice is whether to treat those lots as eligible or set them aside.

Three cautions before reading tiers A and D. The 4,000 sq ft floor was added at the team's request and has no cited source yet. The draft rule does not ban ADUs on hillside-fire lots: it allows them with sprinklers, one parking space, a 20-foot roadway and Title 14 compliance, and City Planning does not apply the restriction to ADUs that state law requires cities to approve. And the draft redefines the area as a "Fire Restriction Area", which this report has not mapped; tier D uses the two layers the report already has. Tier D is not a smaller version of tier C: it has a lower floor and a stricter screen, so it is larger than C wherever no lot is flagged.

```{r dp-part3, results='asis'}
rem <- land_tbl %>% transmute(CPA = cpa, A = eA, B = eB, C = eC, D = eD, flagged = rmD)
rem <- bind_rows(rem, rem %>% summarise(across(-CPA, sum)) %>% mutate(CPA = "All six CPAs"))
rem_hdr <- tibble(CPA = c("Lot floor", "Hillside-fire screen"), A = c("4,000 sq ft", "None"), B = c("4,500 sq ft", "None"),
                  C = c("4,500 sq ft", "Removes flagged lots, except in exempt CPAs"), D = c("4,000 sq ft", "Removes flagged lots everywhere"), flagged = c("", ""))
cat(dp_html(bind_rows(rem_hdr, rem %>% mutate(across(-CPA, fmt))) %>%
              rename(`Tier A` = A, `Tier B` = B, `Tier C` = C, `Tier D` = D, `Tier A lots in both the hillside and fire layers` = flagged),
            caption = "Lots remaining under each tier, six candidate CPAs (single-family and multi-family lots)",
            note = "The first two rows give each tier's lot floor and screen. Tier B was tier A, and tier C was tier B, in earlier versions of this report. Exempt CPAs: Northeast Los Angeles and Silver Lake - Echo Park - Elysian Valley (LAMC 12.22 A.33(c)(4)); of the six candidates only Northeast Los Angeles is exempt, which is why tier D cuts it by about half. This table does not change with the controls.",
            align = c("l", rep("r", 5)), bold_rows = nrow(rem) + 2))
dp_state_line(c("t1", "t2"))
for (t1 in names(dp_opts$t1)) for (t2 in names(dp_opts$t2)) {
  p3 <- map_dfr(focus_cpas, function(cc) { x <- lapply(setNames(tiers, tiers), function(tt) cpa_counts(cc, t1, t2, tt))
    tibble(CPA = cc, lots = x$A$lots, units = x$A$units, eA = x$A$elig, eB = x$B$elig, eC = x$C$elig, eD = x$D$elig,
           oA = x$A$outside, oB = x$B$outside, oC = x$C$outside, oD = x$D$outside) })
  p3 <- bind_rows(p3, p3 %>% summarise(across(-CPA, sum)) %>% mutate(CPA = "All six CPAs"))
  dp_view(dp_html(p3 %>% transmute(CPA, `Lots considered` = fmt(lots), `ADU units` = fmt(units),
                                   A = fmt(eA), B = fmt(eB), C = fmt(eC), D = fmt(eD),
                                   `A ` = fmt(oA), `B ` = fmt(oB), `C ` = fmt(oC), `D ` = fmt(oD),
                                   `A  ` = fmt(100 * units / eA, 1), `B  ` = fmt(100 * units / eB, 1), `C  ` = fmt(100 * units / eC, 1), `D  ` = fmt(100 * units / eD, 1)),
                  caption = "Decision 3. Eligible lots and ADU units under the four tiers, six candidate CPAs (lots; ADU units)",
                  note = "Tier A: lots of 4,000 sq ft or more. Tier B: lots of 4,500 sq ft or more. Tier C: tier B less lots flagged hillside-fire (none in Northeast Los Angeles, which the ordinance exempts). Tier D: tier A less every lot in both the hillside and fire layers, with no exemption. ADU units on lots outside a tier: units built on lots under the tier's floor and, for tiers C and D, on lots its screen removes; they show that ADUs are built on lots the tier leaves out. Units per 100 eligible lots = all ADU units counted ÷ eligible lots.",
                  align = c("l", rep("r", 14)), bold_rows = 7,
                  header = c(" " = 3, "Eligible lots, by tier" = 4, "ADU units on lots outside the tier" = 4, "ADU units per 100 eligible lots" = 4)), t1 = t1, t2 = t2)
}
```

## 4. Which definition of working class

The table sets the report's rule beside two alternatives: industry in place of occupation for test B, and household income against the county median in place of family income against the metro median for test C. For each it shows how many tracts, eligible lots and ADU units fall in working-class tracts.

```{r dp-part4, results='asis'}
dp_state_line(c("t1", "t2", "t3"))
rule_lab <- c(occ = "A + B + C (occupation)", ind = "Industry in place of occupation", hh = "Household income against the county median")
for (t1 in names(dp_opts$t1)) for (t2 in names(dp_opts$t2)) for (t3 in names(dp_opts$t3)) {
  p4 <- map_dfr(c(focus_cpas, "All six CPAs"), function(cc) map_dfr(names(rule_lab), function(t4)
    dp_wc(if (cc == "All six CPAs") NULL else cc, t1, t2, t3, t4) %>% mutate(CPA = cc, Rule = rule_lab[[t4]])))
  dp_view(dp_html(p4 %>% transmute(CPA, `Working-class rule` = Rule, `Working-class tracts` = wc_tracts, `Other tracts` = ot_tracts, `No class` = no_class,
                                   `Eligible lots in working-class tracts` = fmt(wc_elig), `ADU units in working-class tracts` = fmt(wc_units),
                                   `Share of ADU units in working-class tracts` = pct(wc_share),
                                   `ADU units per 100 eligible lots, working-class tracts` = fmt(wc_per100, 1),
                                   `ADU units per 100 eligible lots, other tracts` = ifelse(is.finite(ot_per100), fmt(ot_per100, 1), "no tracts")),
                  caption = "Decision 4. Tracts, eligible lots and ADU units in working-class tracts under three rules (census tracts; lots; ADU units)",
                  note = paste0("A + B + C (occupation): the rule used in the CPA sections. Industry in place of occupation: test B uses the share of workers in agriculture and mining; construction; manufacturing; wholesale and retail trade; transportation and utilities; arts, entertainment, accommodation and food services; and other services (DP03_0033 to _0038, _0043, _0044). Household income against the county median: test C compares tract median household income with the Los Angeles County median ($", fmt(county_mhi),
                                "). Counts cover parcels and ADUs whose tract is assigned to the CPA that contains them. Share: ADU units in working-class tracts ÷ ADU units in the CPA's tracts. No class: tracts with under 100 residents or no published median."),
                  align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 8))), t1 = t1, t2 = t2, t3 = t3)
}
```

For the report's rule, the demographic profile of working-class and other tracts is below. It does not change with the controls.

```{r dp-pooled-d3}
d3_table(d3_build(tract_class), caption = "Demographics of working-class and other tracts, all six CPAs pooled, rule A + B + C",
         note = "ACS 2020–2024 5-year. Pooled over the 317 crosswalk tracts from summed counts. MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points); † = low reliability. The class describes a tract's residents, not the owner of any ADU in it.")
```

## 5. Finalizing our CPAs

The first table applies all four choices to the six candidates. The community tables after it come from the American Community Survey and do not change with the controls.

```{r dp-part5, results='asis'}
dp_state_line(c("t1", "t2", "t3", "t4"))
for (t1 in names(dp_opts$t1)) for (t2 in names(dp_opts$t2)) for (t3 in names(dp_opts$t3)) for (t4 in names(dp_opts$t4)) {
  cols <- map(focus_cpas, function(cc) { d <- cpa_counts(cc, t1, t2, t3); w <- dp_wc(cc, t1, t2, t3, t4)
    c(fmt(d$lots), fmt(d$elig), pct(d$elig / d$lots), fmt(d$units), fmt(d$completed), fmt(d$in_progress), fmt(d$stalled),
      pct(d$completed / d$units), fmt(100 * d$units / d$elig, 1), fmt(100 * d$units / d$sf_lots, 1),
      paste0(w$wc_tracts, " of ", w$wc_tracts + w$ot_tracts), fmt(w$wc_units), pct(w$wc_share),
      fmt(w$wc_per100, 1), ifelse(is.finite(w$ot_per100), fmt(w$ot_per100, 1), "no tracts")) })
  p5 <- tibble(Measure = c("Lots considered", "Eligible lots", "Share of lots considered that are eligible", "ADU units", "Completed", "In progress", "Stalled",
                           "Share of units completed", "ADU units per 100 eligible lots", "ADU units per 100 single-family lots",
                           "Working-class tracts (of tracts with a class)", "ADU units in working-class tracts", "Share of ADU units in working-class tracts",
                           "ADU units per 100 eligible lots, working-class tracts", "ADU units per 100 eligible lots, other tracts"))
  for (i in seq_along(focus_cpas)) p5[[short[i]]] <- cols[[i]]
  dp_view(dp_html(p5, caption = "Decision 5. The six candidate CPAs under the choices above",
                  note = paste0("ADU units: ", window_label, ". Units per 100 single-family lots is kept from the board packet so these figures can be read against what the board saw. Working-class rows cover parcels and ADUs whose tract is assigned to the CPA."),
                  align = c("l", rep("r", 6)), header = c(" " = 1, "San Fernando Valley" = 1, "South LA" = 3, "Eastside" = 2)),
          t1 = t1, t2 = t2, t3 = t3, t4 = t4)
}
qa_add(8, "Decision 5: one finished table for each of the 48 combinations of choices", "48",
       length(dp_opts$t1) * length(dp_opts$t2) * length(dp_opts$t3) * length(dp_opts$t4), length(dp_opts$t1) * length(dp_opts$t2) * length(dp_opts$t3) * length(dp_opts$t4) == 48)
```

```{r dp-script, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat('<script>
(function() {
  var labels = ', jsonlite::toJSON(lapply(dp_opts, as.list), auto_unbox = TRUE), ';
  var keys = ["t1", "t2", "t3", "t4"];
  function update() {
    var st = {};
    keys.forEach(function(k) { st[k] = document.querySelector("input[name=dp_" + k + "]:checked").value; });
    document.querySelectorAll(".dp-view").forEach(function(d) {
      var ok = keys.every(function(k) { var v = d.getAttribute("data-" + k); return !v || v === st[k]; });
      d.style.display = ok ? "" : "none";
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".dp-state").forEach(function(s) {
      s.textContent = s.getAttribute("data-keys").split(",").map(function(k) { return labels[k][st[k]]; }).join(" · ");
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("#dp-controls input").forEach(function(i) { i.addEventListener("change", update); });
  update();
})();
</script>\n', sep = "")
```

### Community profile, side by side

```{r stage8-selection}
comm_rows <- c("Total population" = "Population", "Total households" = "Households",
  "Homeownership rate" = "Homeownership rate",
  "Latino owner households" = "Latino owner households", "Black owner households" = "Black owner households",
  "Latino homeownership rate" = "Latino homeownership rate",
  "Black homeownership rate" = "Black homeownership rate",
  "Latino share of owner households" = "Latino share of owners", "Black share of owner households" = "Black share of owners",
  "Average household income" = "Average household income",
  "Household poverty rate" = "Household poverty rate", "Rent-burden rate" = "Rent-burden rate")
show_compare <- function(cpas, caption) {
  rows <- tibble(Measure = unname(comm_rows))
  for (cc in cpas) {
    comm <- acs_cpa %>% filter(cpa == cc, measure %in% names(comm_rows)) %>% arrange(match(measure, names(comm_rows)))
    stopifnot(nrow(comm) == length(comm_rows))
    rows[[cc]] <- fmt_est(comm$type, comm$estimate, comm$low_reliability); rows[[paste0(cc, "|MOE")]] <- fmt_moe(comm$type, comm$estimate, comm$moe)
  }
  qa_add(8, paste0("Comparison table complete: ", caption), "no missing cells", sum(is.na(as.matrix(rows[, cpas]))),
         !anyNA(as.matrix(rows[, cpas])), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
  rows %>% kable(format = "html", caption = caption, align = c("l", rep("r", 2 * length(cpas))),
                 col.names = c("Measure", as.vector(rbind(cpas, "MOE")))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    footnote(general = "ACS 2020–2024 5-year, for each CPA's tracts (the community profile in each CPA section). MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points); † = low reliability.",
             general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
}
show_compare("Arleta - Pacoima", "Community profile: San Fernando Valley candidate")
show_compare(c("West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert", "South Los Angeles", "Southeast Los Angeles"), "Community profile: South LA candidates")
show_compare(c("Northeast Los Angeles", "Boyle Heights"), "Community profile: Eastside candidates")
```

### Homeownership change, side by side

```{r stage8-own-change}
chg_keys <- c(own_rate = "Homeownership rate", blk_own = "Black owner households", blk_rate = "Share of Black households who own",
              blk_shr = "Black share of owner households", lat_own = "Latino owner households",
              lat_rate = "Share of Latino households who own", lat_shr = "Latino share of owner households")
cell_chg <- function(type, e19, e24, c, m, s) {
  f1 <- function(e) ifelse(type == "count", fmt(e), paste0(fmt(100 * e, 1), "%"))
  paste0(f1(e19), " → ", f1(e24), " (", ifelse(c > 0, "+", ""), ifelse(type == "count", fmt(c), paste0(fmt(100 * c, 1), " pts")),
         " ± ", ifelse(type == "count", fmt(m), fmt(100 * m, 1)), ifelse(s, "*", ""), ")")
}
chg6 <- own_chg_cpa %>% filter(key %in% names(chg_keys)) %>%
  mutate(cell = cell_spec(cell_chg(type, est19, est24, chg, chg_moe, sig), bold = sig, color = ifelse(sig, "black", "#777777")),
         Measure = chg_keys[key]) %>%
  select(Measure, cpa, cell) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cpa, values_from = cell) %>%
  arrange(match(Measure, chg_keys)) %>% select(Measure, all_of(focus_cpas))
qa_add(8, "Homeownership change, side by side: every cell present", "no missing cells", sum(is.na(as.matrix(chg6[, focus_cpas]))),
       !anyNA(as.matrix(chg6[, focus_cpas])), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
names(chg6)[-1] <- short
chg6 %>% kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)),
               caption = "Homeownership change, 2015–2019 to 2020–2024, six candidate CPAs (2015–2019 → 2020–2024, with the change ± its 90% margin of error)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "San Fernando Valley" = 1, "South LA" = 3, "Eastside" = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = paste("Each CPA's tracts in each period (2010 boundaries for 2015–2019, 2020 boundaries for 2020–2024), assigned when at least half of the tract lies inside the CPA.", own_chg_note,
                           "Bold = larger than the margin of error; grey = within it. The same change for each tract is on the layered map in each CPA section, where the focus tracts are outlined."),
           general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
```

## Validation against published counts

```{r appendix-validation}
# Published counts are of permits, so the comparison uses the LADBS permitted group only
adu_val <- filter(adu, source_tag == tag_levels[1])
y <- function(a, b) adu_val %>% filter(issue_year >= a, issue_year <= b)
u_y <- function(yy) sum(adu_val$units[adu_val$issue_year == yy])
crosstown <- adu_val %>% filter(ff_issue_dt >= as.Date("2020-01-01"), ff_issue_dt <= as.Date("2025-04-30"))
tribble(
  ~Benchmark, ~Period, ~`Their count`, ~`This report`, ~Assessment,
  "Crane (2020), UCLA dissertation; LADBS permits", "2017–2018", "Over 6,000 ADUs permitted",
    sprintf("%s projects / %s units", fmt(nrow(y(2017, 2018))), fmt(sum(y(2017, 2018)$units))),
    "Close once step 1b recovers the 2017 permits the inventory flag misses.",
  "Brueckner and Thomaz (2024), Real Estate Economics; LA City Planning permits", "Cumulative through 2019",
    "8,097 parcels (2017: 1,693; 2018: 3,193; 2019: 2,888)",
    sprintf("%s projects (2017: %s; 2018: %s; 2019: %s)", fmt(nrow(y(2017, 2019))), fmt(nrow(y(2017, 2017))),
            fmt(nrow(y(2018, 2018))), fmt(nrow(y(2019, 2019)))),
    "Higher by design: they keep only single-family parcels and drop outlier parcels, excluding the multi-family conversions kept here.",
  "HCD Annual Progress Reports (City self-reports)", "2017–2024",
    "2017: 2,342 | 2018: 4,079 | 2019: 6,747 | 2023: 9,358 | 2024: 9,849 units",
    paste0(c(2017, 2018, 2019, 2023, 2024), ": ", fmt(sapply(c(2017, 2018, 2019, 2023, 2024), u_y)), collapse = " | "),
    "APRs run higher most years: planning-department unit counts self-reported for RHNA credit, with a broader net. A different universe, not an error in either series.",
  "Crosstown LA; same LADBS dataset", "January 1, 2020 to April 30, 2025", "26,835 ADUs permitted",
    sprintf("%s projects / %s units", fmt(nrow(crosstown)), fmt(sum(crosstown$units))),
    "Higher: the structural-inventory fields capture JADUs, multi-family conversions and ADUs embedded in larger permits that description-based counts can miss.") %>%
  tbl(caption = "This report's counts beside published counts (ADU projects; ADU units)",
      note = "Sources: Crane, R. E. (2020), Is Granny in that Flat?, UCLA PhD dissertation; Brueckner, J. K. and Thomaz, S. (2024), ADUs in Los Angeles, Real Estate Economics 52(3): 885–907; HCD Annual Progress Report Table A2 compilations (PermitPathLA; backyardadu.net); Crosstown LA counts as reported in The Eastsider. Published counts are quoted as reported; this report's counts are computed above.")
```

## QA log

```{r stage9-qa}
# =============================================================================
# STAGE 9. QA
# Prints the QA log and stops the knit if any check or benchmark is
# missed without a logged reason. Publishing is done afterwards by publish.sh,
# which knits this file, encrypts the HTML and pushes it.
# =============================================================================
qa_colors <- c(pass = "#1a7f37", explained = "#9a6700", FAIL = "#C0392B")
qa_counts <- table(factor(qa$result, levels = c("pass", "explained", "FAIL")))
qa %>%
  mutate(result = cell_spec(result, color = qa_colors[result], bold = result != "pass"),
         reason = coalesce(reason, "")) %>%
  rename(Stage = stage, Check = check, Expected = expected, Observed = observed, Result = result, Reason = reason) %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE,
        caption = sprintf("QA log: %d checks; %d pass, %d explained, %d fail", nrow(qa), qa_counts[["pass"]], qa_counts[["explained"]], qa_counts[["FAIL"]])) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(general = "pass: matches. explained: the result differs from an earlier run of these steps, and the reason, computed in the build, is logged. FAIL: missed with no reason; the knit stops on these.",
           general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
if (qa_counts[["FAIL"]] > 0)
  stop(sprintf("Stage 9: %d QA check(s) failed without a logged reason: %s", qa_counts[["FAIL"]],
               paste(qa$check[qa$result == "FAIL"], collapse = "; ")), call. = FALSE)
```
